system.notes:
Lone Star Law Enforcement Matrix Division operational host for Sector 4. Handles dispatch logs, warrant databases, and active patrol coordination. Sysops are human officers with backup from automated IC.

Notable data: Outstanding warrants (including your clients'), active patrol routes, CI reports, booking records. Most runners have personal reasons to visit this one.

nodes.name: System Access Node
nodes.description: Restricted gateway. LEMD credentials required. Public access is explicitly denied — connection attempts from unregistered SINs trigger immediate IC response.

nodes.name: I/O Port
nodes.description: Hardlined jackpoints inside Lone Star Sector 4 Precinct. Physical access requires passing through a badge-controlled checkpoint.

nodes.name: Sub-Processing Unit
nodes.description: Routes dispatch traffic, warrant queries, and inter-precinct data transfers.

nodes.name: Data Store
nodes.description: Warrant database, patrol logs, CI contact files, booking records, and active case files. The primary target for most runner-related intrusions.

nodes.name: Slave Node
nodes.description: Controls sector patrol drone routes, surveillance camera network, and electronic door locks at the precinct. High-value secondary target.

nodes.name: Central Processing Unit
nodes.description: Core administrative system. Manages officer access credentials, security sheaf, and encrypted inter-precinct communications.

ioPorts.name: Sector 4 Precinct Hardlines
ioPorts.physicalLocation: 6 hardlined terminals in the LEMD operations room, Sector 4 Precinct. Requires badge access through two checkpoints. Sysop desk is staffed 24/7.

triggerSteps.label: TS 1
triggerSteps.description: Simultaneous Alert (Passive) and Authenticator deployment. LEMD does not have a 'wait and see' posture — any unrecognised access pattern triggers immediate credential verification. Human sysop alerted within 30 seconds.

triggerSteps.label: TS 2
triggerSteps.description: Tracker deploys at SPU. Begins mapping persona movements and transmitting real-time log to the duty sysop. A human officer is now watching the intruder's movements live.

triggerSteps.label: TS 3
triggerSteps.description: Blaster launches from CPU. Overload attack — moderate damage. Lone Star IC is not subtle. If the decker is in VR-Hot, this deals Physical damage.

triggerSteps.label: TS 4
triggerSteps.description: Crippler deploys targeting the intruder's active programs. Begins degrading program ratings — each pass reduces one program's effective rating by 1. Priority: attack and exploit programs.

triggerSteps.label: TS 5
triggerSteps.description: Active Alert declared. All patrol units in Sector 4 alerted to possible Matrix intrusion. Physical security sweep of all registered jackpoint addresses begins. DS access suspended for all non-duty officers.

triggerSteps.label: TS 6
triggerSteps.description: SN drone patrol routes updated to converge on probable physical location. Surveillance cameras in a 3-block radius reoriented. Facial recognition sweep initiated.

triggerSteps.label: TS 7
triggerSteps.description: CPU activates emergency passcode rotation. All current sessions invalidated. Even legitimate officers must re-authenticate. Host effectively locked down for 2 minutes.

triggerSteps.label: TS 8
triggerSteps.description: Full Alert. Knight Errant notified as backup (inter-agency protocol). Physical location of I/O Port hardline confirmed — officers already in the building. Extraction window closing fast.

triggerSteps.label: TS 9
triggerSteps.description: Convergence. GOD trace complete. SIN flagged in the warrant system — the decker now has an outstanding warrant. Physical arrest team en route. This is not the kind of host you run without an exit plan.
